title: Non-secret single-account connection intent
$comment: Blank template null IDs are intentionally not executable. OS_REFERENCE additionally requires --credential-record-dir with an active matching local record; absence, disable or mismatch blocks access. Runtime enforces reference only for OS_REFERENCE, owner/developer confirmations and resolved proof requirement. Flags are not grants or independent identity. Check additionally requires prior user authorization, interactive local confirmation, actual debug metadata and a bounded account GET.
